- One-time credit of 25% applied as a committed usage credit across the first 3 invoices (cap $50k)
- Redwood marketing gets a co-branded case study and logo usage limited to: product page, blog post, and one press release. Customer retains 10 business days to review/approve copy and quote.
- Require signed Marketing Consent Template (attached) before publication.

Legal (Laura) — need approval to accept the 10-business-day review and to allow a quote approval clause (i.e., customer approves but cannot unreasonably withhold). Tessa/Marissa — request approval for the non-standard concession (25% credit, marketing rights) and permission to include the concession in the SOW.

1) Approve one-time credit equal to 25% of estimated first-year usage, applied as a credit across the first 2 invoices (not 3) and capped at $40,000. This must be represented as a separate commercial credit line in the SOW (do not reduce list price in systems).
2) Marketing/co-branded case study: approve co-branded case study and limited logo usage (product page, blog post, press release) provided Veridian signs the Marketing Consent and we include a 15-business-day review window (extended from their 10) — we need time for legal and PR review.
3) Legal to review and bless the quote-approval clause: customer can request edits but cannot veto Redwood's right to publish an anonymized, aggregate results case study if a reasonable edit request is not made within the review window. Laura — please provide redline by EOD.
4) Finance (Connor) — flag commercial credit as one-time marketing concession; we need a one-line approval in the deal handbook for audit.
5) This approval is contingent on signed SOW and Marketing Consent before any public mention.

Connor, Laura, confirm quickly and I will notify Dylan to finalize with Veridian. Marissa
